summary: Iteration 37 — P1 DatePicker swap + P2 absentees Mongo aggregation. Backend 48/48 pytest pass (9 new iter37 absentees-aggregation tests covering shape/keys/sort/filters/empty/RBAC + 14 iter36 + 25 iter35 full regression). Frontend Playwright on AttendancePage (Mark students, Absentees day+month modes, Teacher attendance) and TimetablePage all confirmed: native input[type=date] is gone everywhere, DatePicker trigger/popover/today/day/month testids work, label renders as 'Tue, May 19, 2026' / 'January 2026', picking a date triggers a reload (network call observed and trigger label updates), absentees DatePicker correctly flips between day-grid (31 cells) and month-grid (12 cells) based on the Day/Week/Month period toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: teacher_attendance.py list_absentees: aggregation looks correct, but the last_absent_status enrichment performs N+1 find_one() calls (one per matched absentee). For the demo this is negligible; at scale (hundreds of absentees per month) consider folding it into the same pipeline using $push of {date,status} pairs and computing the max-by-date in $reduce, or doing a single $in lookup keyed by (student_id,date) after the aggregation.

DatePicker.jsx: outside-click handler attaches on mousedown on document — works, but the popover is positioned with absolute + z-50; inside modal/drawer contexts it could be clipped by overflow:hidden ancestors. Not an issue on these three pages, just noting for future reuse.
DatePicker.jsx month mode does not honor minDate/maxDate (documented in the prop comment but worth a runtime guard or doc note in the picker).
$match expr stage uses {$gt: [{$add: [absent_days,sick_days]}, 0]} — fine, but a simpler {$or:[{absent_days:{$gt:0}},{sick_days:{$gt:0}}]} would let Mongo use field stats. Micro-optimisation only.
